references.text: The revelation of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

Why spend money on what is not bread, and your wages on what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will eat what is good, and your soul will delight in rich food. Turn your ear to me and come to me; listen, so that your soul may live.
He who has ears, let him hear.
And he called the people to himself and said: 'Hear and understand.'
Whoever is from God hears the words of God. You do not hear because you are not from God.
